# Inconsolata

Unmodified variable WOFF2 subsets imported on 2026-09-09, normal style, weights 200–900. Licensed under the [SIL OFL 1.1](OFL.txt). Both the app and standalone design previews load these files through `tokens/fonts.css`.

| inconsolata-latin-ext-wght.woff2 | `36b1d9723a02800e46379a0b7c78550e1ffc9880e1fe9d3b51711548f846d0a0` |

The app uses Inconsolata for headings and body text. The monospace token uses `ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace`.
